content.what_it_is: Fixed-form Fortran bathymetry generator, byte-identical to the single_vessel_cohesive copy. It reads dimensions/spacing/channel geometry from bathy_param.txt (L6-L16), allocates coordinates/depth (L18), initializes a constant channel (L20-L26), applies linearly sloping banks beyond half-width (L28-L35), and writes formatted depth rows to depth.txt (L37-L42).
unresolved: For even Nglob, L24 produces asymmetric coordinates `(1-Nglob/2)..Nglob/2`; using abs(Y) in L30-L32 therefore yields unequal side extents/depths instead of a cell-centered symmetric channel.
The 9000-value format at L41 can revert to an additional record when Mglob>9000 at L39, splitting a logical grid row.
Input geometry is unvalidated, so bad dimensions/spacings or a steep slope can create allocation failures or negative depths. I/O and allocation status are unchecked.
This is an exact case-local duplicate of the cohesive generator, so defects/fixes can diverge between copies.
